Executive Order 11205
REVOKING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 107291  OF SEPTEMBER 16, 1957
B y virtue o f the authority vested in me as President o f the United 
States, the position o f Special Assistant to the President for Personnel 
Management, established by Executive Order No. 10729 o f September 
16,1957, is abolished, and that Order is hereby revoked.
